item.title: Zoox Robotaxis Now on Uber in Las Vegas: What It Means
item.description: Uber riders in Las Vegas can now ride Amazon‑owned Zoox robotaxis for free. Explore the tech, impact, and future of this autonomous partnership today.

item.title: Zoox Robotaxis Arrive on Uber App in Las Vegas for Riders
item.description: Zoox’s custom‑built robotaxis are now bookable through Uber in Las Vegas, creating the first third‑party ride‑hailing partnership for fully driverless cars and giving riders a new autonomous option.

item.title: Zoox Gets First NHTSA Approval for Robotaxi Rides
item.description: Amazon’s Zoox becomes the first steering‑wheel‑free robotaxi to receive NHTSA approval for paid rides, launching in Las Vegas next month.
